title: A Novel Electrophoretic Deposited Coordination Supramolecular Network Film for Detecting Phosphate and Biophosphate

material_class.structural_family: 1D lanthanide–nalidixate coordination chain assembling into a 3D CSN via π–π stacking

synthesis.procedure: CSN-Gd was prepared by mixing GdCl3·6H2O (0.01 mmol), HNA (0.03 mmol), aqueous Et3N (0.05 mL, 1 M), DMF (1.5 mL), and deionized water (3 mL) in a 10 mL beaker and stirring for 10 min. The resulting solution was left at ambient temperature for crystallization; block colorless crystals formed after one week. Yield 73% based on GdCl3·6H2O.
synthesis.time: stirred 10 min; crystallized for one week
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: solution left at ambient temperature; block colorless crystals obtained after one week

source_locations.location: Description of the single-crystal structure of CSN-Gd; Figure 1

material_class.structural_family: isostructural 1D lanthanide–nalidixate coordination chain / CSN (same structure as CSN-Gd by PXRD)

synthesis.procedure: CSN-Eu was obtained analogously to CSN-Gd, replacing GdCl3·6H2O with EuCl3·6H2O (same ligand/base/solvent amounts: HNA 0.03 mmol, aqueous Et3N 0.05 mL of 1 M, DMF 1.5 mL, deionized water 3 mL; 10 mL beaker, stirred 10 min, ambient crystallization for one week). Yield 61% based on EuCl3·6H2O. Thin films were later deposited from n-hexane by EPD (not the crystal synthesis).

reagents.amount: used in place of 0.01 mmol GdCl3·6H2O

reagents.name: triethylamine
reagents.amount: 0.05 mL of 1 M aqueous solution (as for CSN-Gd)

synthesis.time: stirred 10 min; crystallized for one week (as for CSN-Gd)
synthesis.vessel_or_method: same as CSN-Gd (10 mL beaker; ambient crystallization)

properties.summary: CSN-Eu films show ligand-sensitized EuIII red emission (5D0→7FJ, J=1–4) with I(7F2)/I(7F1)=4.6, a relatively intense 5D0→7F4 band, and double-exponential decay (two emissive centers). The film is a selective luminescent sensor for H2PO4− and ATP in aqueous Tris buffer (stable roughly pH 5–8), with Stern–Volmer quenching and demonstrated ATP recovery in spiked bovine serum.

properties.summary: CSN-Tb films show typical TbIII 5D4→7FJ (J=6–3) emission upon 350 nm excitation with no residual ligand emission, indicating efficient sensitization. Emission is weaker than CSN-Eu. Decay at 545 nm is double-exponential (two emissive centers); numerical lifetime values are given only in SI Figure S4 and were not extracted as numbers from the main text.
